Paris Saint-Germain have been named the best men's club of the season, retaining last year's title. Luis Enrique's team won their second consecutive Champions League title after beating Arsenal on penalties in the final. Few teams in the competition's modern era had managed to win back-to-back European Cups, and PSG did so with a squad featuring ten Ballon d'Or nominees.
